claims: Saint Louis University (SLU) was founded in 1818.
Saint Louis University (SLU) is a private Jesuit research university.
Saint Louis University (SLU) has a 9:1 student-to-faculty ratio.
Saint Louis University (SLU) offers over 100 undergraduate programs.
Saint Louis University (SLU) is located in St. Louis, Missouri.
Saint Louis University (SLU) has a campus in Madrid, Spain.
Saint Louis University (SLU) serves around 12,000+ students.
Saint Louis University (SLU)'s acceptance rate is approximately 75% as of 2024.
Saint Louis University (SLU)'s average GPA is around 3.79.
Saint Louis University (SLU)'s tuition for the 2023-2024 academic year was $53,244.
Saint Louis University (SLU) has new "Tuition Promise" initiatives starting in fall 2026 for eligible low-income families.
Saint Louis University (SLU)'s main "Frost" campus is in midtown St. Louis.
Saint Louis University (SLU) has a separate Health Sciences Center.
56.5% of Saint Louis University (SLU) students are female.
43% of Saint Louis University (SLU) students are male.
Saint Louis University (SLU)'s mascot is "Billiken".
Saint Louis University (SLU) is active in research in vaccine development.
Saint Louis University (SLU) is active in research in chronic pain.
Saint Louis University (SLU) is active in research in environmental protection.
Saint Louis University (SLU) has the Pius XII Memorial Library.
Saint Louis University (SLU) has the Edward A. Doisy Research Center.
